25
Ntomadan ho afɔrebɔdeɛ
(Eksodɔs 35.4-9)
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2#Eks 35.5, 22 Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmmɛma me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ. Obiara a n’akoma pɛ no nkyɛn na monnye me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ. 3Na yei ne mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ a monnye no wɔn nkyɛn no: Sika, dwetɛ, kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, 4bibire, asaawa a ɛbere dum, koogyan, asaawa fufuo, mmirekyie nwi, 5adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, sukraman nwoma ne okuo nnua; 6kanea ho ngo, ɔsra ngo ne nnuhwam a wɔhyeɛ ho aduro, 7apopobibire aboɔ ne aboɔ a wɔde bɛsisi asɔfotadeɛ no ne adaaboɔ no mu no. 8Na ma wɔnyɛ tenabea kronkron mma me na mentena wɔn mu. 9#Eks 25.40 Sɛdeɛ me ara merebɛkyerɛ wo tenabea no tebea ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa tebea no, saa ara na monyɛ no.
Apam adaka no yɛbea
(Eksodɔs 37.1-9)
10 # Eks 37.1-9 Na wɔmfa okuo nyɛ adaka a ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na ne korɔn bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 11Na fa sika amapa dura ho, emu ne ɛho nyinaa na dura, na yɛ sika hankra twa ho hyia. 12Na gu sika nkaa nnan, na fa tuatua ne nan nnan no ho; nkaa mmienu nni fa ha, na nkaa mmienu nni fa ha. 13Na fa okuo sene mpoma, na fa sika dura ho. 14Na fa poma no wurawura nkaa no mu wɔ adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔmfa nsoa adaka no. 15Mpoma no nwurawura adaka no ho nkaa no mu; wɔnnyiyi mmfiri mu. 16#Eks 25.21 Na fa Adanseɛ a mede bɛma woɔ no hyɛ adaka no mu.
17 # Heb 4.16 Na fa sika amapa yɛ mpata adwa, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 18Na sika a waboro na fa yɛ Kerubim mmienu no, na fa sisi mpata adwa no tiri mmienu no so. 19Na yɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha ne kerub baako wɔ etire ha. Mpata adwa no mu na momma kerubim no nyi adie wɔ ne tiri mmienu so soɔ. 20Na kerubim no ntrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu ɔsoro mfa wɔn ntaban no nkata mpata adwa no so, na wɔn ani nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho; mpata adwa no so na kerubim no ani nkyerɛkyerɛ. 21#Eks 34.29; 1 Ah 8.9; Heb 9.4 Na fa mpata adwa no si adaka no so, na adaka no mu na fa Adanseɛ a mede bɛma woɔ no hyɛ. 22#Num 7.89 Na ɛhɔ na me ne wo bɛhyia, na mafiri mpata adwa no so wɔ kerubim mmienu a wɔwɔ Adanseɛ adaka no soɔ no ntam maka wo nnoɔma a mɛhyɛ wo sɛ fa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa.
Ɛpono no ho nhyehyɛɛ
(Eksodɔs 37.10-16)
23 # Eks 37.10-16 Na fa okuo yɛ ɛpono, ne tentene basafa baako, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne korɔn bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 24Na fa sika amapa dura ho, na fa sika hankra twa ho hyia. 25Na yɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne trɛ te sɛ nsam hyia, na fa sika hankra twa mfemfamho no ho hyia. 26Na yɛ sika nkaa nnan, na fa nkaa no sisi ntweaso nnan a ɛwowɔ ne nan ho no so. 27Mfemfamho no ase pa ara na nkaa no nnie, na ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔde mpoma bɛwurawura mu de asoa ɛpono no. 28Na fa okuo sene mpoma no, na fa sika duradura ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no. 29Na yɛ ɛso nyowa ne nyowaa ne nkoraa ne nkuruwa a wɔde bɛhwie; sika amapa na fa yɛ. 30#Lew 24.5-6 Na fa kyerɛ paanoo sisi ɛpono no so wɔ m’anim daa.
Kaneadua no
(Eksodɔs 37.17-24)
31 # Eks 37.17-24 Na fa sika amapa a waboro yɛ kaneadua; ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho nhwiren nkuramu, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren no mfiri ɛno ara mu. 32Na nsa nsia ntuatua ho, kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa ntuatua fa ha, na kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa nso ntuatua fa ha. 33Nhwiren nkuramu mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren, na nhwiren nkuramu mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren. Saa ara na yɛ wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no ho no ho. 34Na kaneadua no ho nhwiren nkuramu a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ nnan, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren. 35Na kukuduuduu nsisi nsa mmienu mmienu a ɛtuatua ho no ase, wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no mu no ase. 36Ɛho kukuduuduu ne ɛho nsa no mfiri mu ara; ne nyinaa na wɔmfa sika amapa a waboro nyɛ no baako. 37Na yɛ ɛso nkanea nson, na wɔmfa ne nkanea no nsisi so, na ɛnnɛre wɔ anim nkyerɛ fa hɔ. 38Na ɛho daawa ne ɛho nso nkuruwa nyɛ sika amapa. 39Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na wɔmfa nyɛ, ne ɛho nnoɔma yi nyinaa. 40#Eks 26.30; Aso 7.44; Heb 8.5 Na hwɛ na yɛ no sɛdeɛ ne nsususoɔ a wɔde akyerɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ no.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmmɛma me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ. Obiara a n’akoma pɛ no nkyɛn na monnye me mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ. Na yei ne mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ a monnye no wɔn nkyɛn no: Sika, dwetɛ, kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, bibire, asaawa a ɛbere dum, koogyan, asaawa fufuo, mmirekyie nwi, adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ, sukraman nwoma ne okuo nnua; kanea ho ngo, ɔsra ngo ne nnuhwam a wɔhyeɛ ho aduro, apopobibire aboɔ ne aboɔ a wɔde bɛsisi asɔfotadeɛ no ne adaaboɔ no mu no. Na ma wɔnyɛ tenabea kronkron mma me na mentena wɔn mu. Sɛdeɛ me ara merebɛkyerɛ wo tenabea no tebea ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa tebea no, saa ara na monyɛ no.


Na wɔmfa okuo nyɛ adaka a ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na ne korɔn bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na fa sika amapa dura ho, emu ne ɛho nyinaa na dura, na yɛ sika hankra twa ho hyia. Na gu sika nkaa nnan, na fa tuatua ne nan nnan no ho; nkaa mmienu nni fa ha, na nkaa mmienu nni fa ha. Na fa okuo sene mpoma, na fa sika dura ho. Na fa poma no wurawura nkaa no mu wɔ adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔmfa nsoa adaka no. Mpoma no nwurawura adaka no ho nkaa no mu; wɔnnyiyi mmfiri mu. Na fa Adanseɛ a mede bɛma woɔ no hyɛ adaka no mu.
Na fa sika amapa yɛ mpata adwa, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na sika a waboro na fa yɛ Kerubim mmienu no, na fa sisi mpata adwa no tiri mmienu no so. Na yɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha ne kerub baako wɔ etire ha. Mpata adwa no mu na momma kerubim no nyi adie wɔ ne tiri mmienu so soɔ. Na kerubim no ntrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu ɔsoro mfa wɔn ntaban no nkata mpata adwa no so, na wɔn ani nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho; mpata adwa no so na kerubim no ani nkyerɛkyerɛ. Na fa mpata adwa no si adaka no so, na adaka no mu na fa Adanseɛ a mede bɛma woɔ no hyɛ. Na ɛhɔ na me ne wo bɛhyia, na mafiri mpata adwa no so wɔ kerubim mmienu a wɔwɔ Adanseɛ adaka no soɔ no ntam maka wo nnoɔma a mɛhyɛ wo sɛ fa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa.


Na fa okuo yɛ ɛpono, ne tentene basafa baako, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne korɔn bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. Na fa sika amapa dura ho, na fa sika hankra twa ho hyia. Na yɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne trɛ te sɛ nsam hyia, na fa sika hankra twa mfemfamho no ho hyia. Na yɛ sika nkaa nnan, na fa nkaa no sisi ntweaso nnan a ɛwowɔ ne nan ho no so. Mfemfamho no ase pa ara na nkaa no nnie, na ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔde mpoma bɛwurawura mu de asoa ɛpono no. Na fa okuo sene mpoma no, na fa sika duradura ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no. Na yɛ ɛso nyowa ne nyowaa ne nkoraa ne nkuruwa a wɔde bɛhwie; sika amapa na fa yɛ. Na fa kyerɛ paanoo sisi ɛpono no so wɔ m’anim daa.


Na fa sika amapa a waboro yɛ kaneadua; ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho nhwiren nkuramu, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren no mfiri ɛno ara mu. Na nsa nsia ntuatua ho, kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa ntuatua fa ha, na kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa nso ntuatua fa ha. Nhwiren nkuramu mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren, na nhwiren nkuramu mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren. Saa ara na yɛ wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no ho no ho. Na kaneadua no ho nhwiren nkuramu a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ nnan, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren. Na kukuduuduu nsisi nsa mmienu mmienu a ɛtuatua ho no ase, wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no mu no ase. Ɛho kukuduuduu ne ɛho nsa no mfiri mu ara; ne nyinaa na wɔmfa sika amapa a waboro nyɛ no baako. Na yɛ ɛso nkanea nson, na wɔmfa ne nkanea no nsisi so, na ɛnnɛre wɔ anim nkyerɛ fa hɔ. Na ɛho daawa ne ɛho nso nkuruwa nyɛ sika amapa. Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na wɔmfa nyɛ, ne ɛho nnoɔma yi nyinaa. Na hwɛ na yɛ no sɛdeɛ ne nsususoɔ a wɔde akyerɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
